summary: Frontend-only validation of dynamic recipient rules by profiling ('taller') on Repair Quotes Send-to-Client. All 4 scenarios (A one-taller / B two-taller / C no-taller fallback to primary / D equipment regression) PASS end-to-end in preview UI. routeTallerRecipients in Quotes.jsx correctly gates on purposeForQuoteCategory('repair')==='taller', uses GET /clients/{id}/consolidated-contacts, filters strictly by purposes.includes('taller'), preloads To badge in 'Personalizar Comunicación' (email-modal) for A and C, and only opens contact-select-modal for B (with exactly the 2 taller contacts) and for D (equipment, unchanged behavior).

issues: Pre-existing hydration warnings: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected as child of <tr>/<tbody> by visual-edit wrapper — NOT related to this feature; also DialogContent missing aria-describedby warning in contact-select-modal and email-modal (a11y).

critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.jsx routeTallerRecipients (L2460-2496): logic is correct and matches spec. Strict matching Array.isArray(c.purposes) && c.purposes.includes('taller') — good, empty purposes array is NOT treated as taller.

Scenario B correctly filters modal to only taller contacts by pre-setting contactList with tallerContacts before opening — verified UI shows exactly 2 rows (excluded 'facturacion' + inherited principal contact without purposes).

Scenario C fallback: contacts.find(c => c.scope === 'principal') || contacts[0]. Works when the primary client has at least 1 email-bearing contact. Edge case: if consolidated-contacts is empty entirely (or none have email), falls back to openContactSelect with empty list — acceptable but could be surfaced as a toast to operator.

Setting setActionLoading(null) BEFORE opening the modal in the B branch is fine, but branch B mutates setContactList(tallerContacts) directly (bypasses openContactSelect) — this duplicates state-set logic; consider refactoring openContactSelect to accept an override list to reduce duplication.

quote?.quote_category is read from the local list; if a quote's category is missing on the client (e.g. loaded via search) purposeForQuoteCategory returns null and falls through to standard flow — spec-compliant, but could be defensively logged for observability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified fully. Trigger testid = quote-actions-{quote_id} (dropdown three-dots). Action button testid = send-to-client-btn-{quote_id}. contact-select-modal opens only in Scenario B (2+ taller) and regression D (equipment). Scenarios A and C open the 'Personalizar Comunicación' email-modal directly with the correct email badge preloaded in 'Para (Destinatarios)'. To reproduce, ensure quote_status ∈ {Borrador, Enviada, ...} that enables the send_to_client action (send-to-client-btn is rendered when canEditNonConfig && !hidden — admin always sees it).
